description: Cohort Retention Heatmap with Survival Curves by Office Solution The Cohort Retention Heatmap with Survival Curves provides deep retention, churn, and lifecycle analytics in Power BI. It pairs an intuitive cohort matrix with Kaplan-Meier survival curves, offering a clear dual perspective on customer decay and account retention over time. Key Concepts: Cohort Matrix: Displays signup or origination cohorts along the Y-axis and tenure periods (months on book, days) along the X-axis with heat gradients. Survival Curves: Overlay or dedicated survival curves showing retention decay across segments with median survival time (T50) benchmarks. Flexible Metrics: Supports retention percentages (0–100%), active user counts, and recurring balances. Key Features: Three View Modes: Switch between Combined Mode (side-by-side), Heatmap Only Mode, or Curves Only Mode. Dynamic Field Switching: Map multiple fields to toggle cohort keys, periods, or metrics directly from toolbar dropdowns. Tenure Play Scrubber: Animate period by period to observe retention progression across cohorts. Cohort Comparison: Select and inspect multiple cohorts simultaneously to analyze benchmark variance. What-If LTV Drawer: Simulate retention rate improvements (+1% to +10%) and estimate residual customer lifetime value.
